verdict.rationale: There is no documented data-export or migration feature. Getting out relies on general-purpose access: full root SSH to VMs lets users copy files off themselves, Notebooks are standard Jupyter, Deployments run standard container images, and the service advertises 'cancel anytime'. A hands-on report says data transfer was very slow and SSH access was hard to get, which adds friction to moving data out. Missing for 10: a first-party export tool or documented export procedure, coverage of account and metadata export (templates, workflows, deployment configs), any statement on data retention after cancellation, and independent confirmation of a successful full exit.
